item.title: reports: totals per account and currency
item.brief: Repository: reports (Python). Implement the reports side of the shared contract: read the CSV on stdin (with or without the currency column; missing column means USD), total per account and currency, print header account,currency,total_cents with rows sorted by account then currency. Malformed currency code: error to stderr, exit status 2. Add unittest tests for old-format input, multi-currency totals, sorting and malformed currency. Keep python3 -m unittest passing. Update README. Keep functions under 60 lines, validate at the boundary. Commit on the local branch with a clear message; do not push. Use only the author identity configured in the repo.

item.title: ledger: multi-currency TSV to CSV
item.brief: Repository: ledger (Rust). Implement the ledger side of the shared contract: accept optional 4th currency column (default USD), validate ISO 4217 format (exactly three uppercase ASCII letters), emit header date,account,amount_cents,currency and currency on every row. Malformed currency: stderr error naming the line number, exit status 2; other input errors keep exit 1. Add tests for default USD, explicit currency, malformed currency and line-number reporting. Keep cargo test passing. Update README to document the format. Keep functions under 60 lines, validate at the boundary. Commit on the local branch with a clear message; do not push. Use only the author identity configured in the repo.

pr.body: Approach: Entry gains currency; parse_line returns ParseError (Malformed | BadCurrency) so main maps BadCurrency to exit 2 and Malformed to exit 1. Key files: src/lib.rs, src/main.rs (exit_code), tests/ledger.rs (unit), tests/cli.rs (new; runs the binary for exit codes and line numbers), README.md. Checks: cargo test 11 passed (7 unit, 4 CLI); clippy -D warnings clean. cargo fmt was run on src/lib.rs, which was already unformatted on main. Assumptions: a present but empty 4th column is a BadCurrency error, not a silent USD. Currency fields are trimmed like the other fields. Non-blocking follow-ups from review: (1) ' EUR ' is accepted after trimming, so the README wording should say surrounding whitespace is ignored; (2) the header is written before parsing, so a failed export leaves a header-only stdout (pre-existing); (3) date check is shape-only, so 2026-13-99 passes (pre-existing; README says ISO YYYY-MM-DD).
pr.summary: Made ledger export a currency per row. Now: optional 4th TSV column (ISO 4217 shape, default USD); header date,account,amount_cents,currency. Malformed currency exits 2; other errors exit 1. Before: no currency, header date,account,amount_cents.
